Plumbing Services in Columbia, SC

2nd Wind Heating & Air Conditioning provides licensed plumbing services in Columbia, SC and across the Midlands, from a dripping faucet to a whole-home repipe. The approach matches the rest of our trades: diagnose the cause, document it, and present the options with prices before any work begins. Same-day emergency service is available for residential properties, and the website chat is staffed 24/7 for the problems that announce themselves at midnight.

You approve scope and price up front. Cloud 10 members on our maintenance plans receive priority scheduling on plumbing calls along with the rest of their service.

Water Heaters

Hot water is the plumbing system’s biggest appliance and its most common failure. Our water heater services cover repair, replacement, and the maintenance that extends tank life, and our tankless water heater services handle the on-demand alternative, from sizing through descaling.

Pipes, Leaks, and Gas Lines

Supply and drain piping ages on its own schedule. Our pipe repair and general plumbing services handle the everyday failures, while leak detection finds hidden water loss without opening walls at random. Winter cold snaps drive our frozen and burst pipe repair, aging systems move to whole-home repiping, and gas line services cover installation, testing, and repair for the fuel side of the house.

Kitchens, Bathrooms, and Fixtures

Fixtures are where the household actually meets its plumbing. Our kitchen and bathroom plumbing services cover fixture installation, disposals, and remodel work, with faucet repair and toilet repair handling the two fixtures that waste the most water when they fail quietly.

Water Quality, Pressure, and Drainage

What comes out of the tap and how hard it arrives both have fixes. Our water softener services address scale, water treatment and filtration addresses taste, odor, and well water contaminants, and water pressure assessments measure and correct pressure that is quietly stressing every connected fixture. Below the house, sump pump services keep crawl spaces and low spots dry. Clogs and sewer problems run through our drain services.
